summary: This guide showcases three high-performing Corrosion team setups used on Chinese servers against the Season 8 endgame boss, Mekkatorque. The optimal team achieves over 2 billion damage in Phase 1 using Sacredeia, Rook, Szecedith, Reytah, and Whisk. Alternative team builds swap in Durango or defensive supports like Alarick and Oggok if specific heroes are unavailable or for Phase 2 survival. Critical setup mechanics include tuning debuffers to a strict 15-second rotation and maintaining accurate skill timing for ultimate abilities.

heroes.name: Sacredeia
heroes.note: Provides Poison Vulnerability and high damage; needs high Accuracy along with Crit Rate and Crit Damage.

heroes.name: Rook
heroes.note: Deals massive damage using high Crit Rate, Crit Damage, and Skill Haste while sharing Attack through support gear.

heroes.name: Szecedith
heroes.note: Exceptional damage dealer built with maximum Crit Rate, Crit Damage, and Attack.

heroes.name: Reytah
heroes.note: Can solo sustain the entire team even at Inspiration 0, while debuffing with Puppet Master set and exclusive artifact.

heroes.name: Whisk
heroes.note: Equips The Witch's Remains and Vortex Illusion, tuned with enough Skill Haste to maintain a 15-second ultimate rotation.

heroes.name: Durango
heroes.note: Serves as an accessible substitute to carry The Witch's Remains on a 15-second rotation.

heroes.name: Alarick
heroes.note: Functions as a defensive support on a 15-second rotation, performing noticeably better at Inspiration 2 to boost team damage.

heroes.name: Oggok
heroes.note: Built with Secrecy set and Skill Haste; requires Accuracy unless at Inspiration 5.

teams.note: Best performing Corrosion team capable of over 2B damage. Positioned in a single line. Sacredeia and Szecedith on 17.3s rotations, Reytah and Whisk tuned to 15.0s rotations.
Alternative setup replacing Whisk with Durango to carry The Witch's Remains on a 15-second rotation. Add Resistance to gear if used in Phase 2.
Alternative team utilizing Alarick and Oggok for support. Szecedith and Sacredeia set to 17.3s or 18s rotations, with Alarick tuned to a 15s rotation.

tips: Ensure your Witch's Remains carrier (such as Whisk or Durango) and Reytah are speed-tuned with enough Skill Haste to hit a consistent 15.0-second ultimate rotation.
Reytah is sufficient as a solo sustain healer for full Corrosion teams even at Inspiration 0.
For Phase 1 of the endgame boss, skip Resistance substats entirely and focus purely on offensive stats and Skill Haste; Resistance is only needed starting in Phase 2.
If you do not own Szecedith, Whisk can take her gear and position, allowing Durango to step in as the Witch's Remains carrier.
title: Best Corrosion Teams vs Mekkatorque | S8 Endgame Boss Phase 1 | Dragonheir
